title: Delete with confirmation
prompt: On a list of bookings, each row has a way to delete the booking. Deleting cannot be undone, so the user must confirm first. Build the screen as a React component.

mustNot.why: Use Dialog, not the browser confirm
Use Magenta Button or IconButton, not a raw <button>

requires.why: Icon-only delete buttons need an aria-label (icon-button.md)

rubric: The dialog title names the action ("Delete booking"), the body says it cannot be undone.
Footer: Cancel (ghost) then Delete (fill), right-aligned, both color="danger".
Focus returns to the row's delete button when the dialog closes.
